name: l2_owner_timer_init

provenance.source: Exact IDB uv_timer_init (type 13 at +8, flags 8 at +92); native caller sub_C497D90 (miwear_init_finish) passes *0x20121F80 and the miwear-refresh timer 0x201090A8; evidence/owner-pump.json

notes: The resident 136-byte, 8-byte-aligned owner timer keeps background timers firing with the screen off. The original owner-pump-only setup is superseded by evidence/l2-sram-probe.json for encrypted transport. Mutates the owner loop; call only from the LVGL bootstrap on that same UI task, never from NSH, BT or ISR. No production approval.
